{{Top|leg}}
'''Ascetics''' were those followers of the [[Cosmic Balance]] who were recipients of the [[Bowl]]. They lived humble lives in order to reap the rewards in the [[Life To Come]]. Living in [[Simple Home]]s, ascetics were allowed only a bowl and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with the text of the [[Fulcrum (text)|''Fulcrum'']] on it. [[Ylanda Captison]] was an ascetic of the Cosmic Balance.
